description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of frames and memory usage in GB for various models, including VideoLLaMB-R, PLLaVA, LLaVA-NeXT, and VideoLLAVA. The x-axis represents the number of frames, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1000, marked at intervals of 200. The y-axis represents memory usage in GB, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 400, marked at intervals of 50. The plot displays five lines, each representing a different model or category. The red dashed line remains mostly off the plot, with a small visible section near the origin. The brown dashed line, representing VideoLLaMB-R, starts at around 20 GB at 0 frames and increases to approximately 30 GB at 1000 frames. The green dashed line, representing PLLaVA, begins at around 20 GB and rises to about 75 GB at 1000 frames. The blue dashed line, representing LLaVA-NeXT, starts at roughly 25 GB and reaches around 130 GB at 1000 frames. The purple dashed line, representing VideoLLAVA, begins at approximately 30 GB and sharply increases to over 400 GB at around 300 frames. All lines exhibit an increasing trend as the number of frames grows, with VideoLLAVA showing the most dramatic rise.
